YAO Duo-xiang，XIU Qi-kun，CHEN Yi-jun\* ，WU Xu-ri( School of Life Science and Technology，China Pharmaceutical University，Nanjing 210009，China)Abstract With the development of modern medicine and pharmacy，the situation of multiple drugs for patients is becoming more and more common． The adverse drug reactions caused by drug interactions are also becoming more and more serious． And due to adverse reactions caused by drug interactions and drug toxicants，the case that is forcing drugs to withdraw from the market is also increasing year by year internationally． Therefore，the preclinical study of new drug interactions has become an important link in the development of new drugs． Two main factors of drug-drug interactions are summarized in this review: transporter and CYP enzymes to explore the impact of drug interactions to provide a reference for the study of the mechanism of drug interactions，including P-gly， multidrug resistance-associated proteins，breast cancer resistance proteins，etc． Especially in the course of drug development，the study of drug candidate inhibition or induction of transporters is also essential for evaluating the safety of new drugs． For drugs with multiple roles in the development of new drugs，cross-drug interactions that may occur should be studied to reduce adverse reactions due to drug interactions． Based on this，the future research on drug interactions in the development of new drugs is prospected．
